item.title: No arrests made after sheriff and FBI conduct court-authorized search near Guthrie home
item.description: The FBI and sheriff's office conducted a court-authorized search at a location near Nancy Guthrie's home, but ultimately made no arrests. NBC News' Erin McLaughlin has details on what officials had to say about the overnight search.

item.description: At least a half-dozen top officials in the current Trump administration have connections to Jeffrey Epstein, according to an NBC News review of some of the over 3 million documents the Justice Department has released

item.title: South America just won its first medal in the Winter Olympics
item.description: Alpine skier Lucas Pinheiro Braathen and skeleton competitor Nicole Rocha Silveira, both from Brazil, will compete this weekend in the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: At the Winter Olympics, drones have become the breakout star
item.description: The breakout star of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics isn’t an athlete. It's the drones.

item.title: Figure skating world shocked by Ilia Malinin's Olympic performance
item.description: The figure skating community described the shock they felt watching Ilia Malinin’s mistake-ridden performance Friday night, trying to help fans understand how the sport's most dominant athlete performed so far below expectations.

item.title: Canada and Sweden's curling teams swear at each other after a cheating accusation
item.description: The action got heated on the ice during the men’s curling contest between Canada and Sweden on Friday, resulting in a shouting match between the two sides.

item.title: From the sports desk: South America breaks 102-year drought
item.description: Hello from Milan and Cortina, where Brazil’s Lucas Pinheiro Braathen won gold in the men’s giant slalom, making history for all of South America.

item.title: U.S. Olympic bobsledder is going for gold in her fifth Winter Games
item.description: Team USA bobsledder Elana Meyers Taylor is heading into her fifth Olympics as the most decorated Black Winter Games athlete ever. NBC News' Marquise Francis talks to the 41-year-old Olympian who is going for gold even if she's the underdog.

item.title: Broken bones, burning eyes: How Trump's DHS deploys 'less lethal' weapons on protesters
item.description: Federal immigration officers have repeatedly used less lethal weapons in ways that appear to violate their own policies or general policing guidelines, unless they believed their lives were in danger, NBC News found.
